permits.description: renovation of 1 apartment: one unit on 4th level. new bedroom. new kitchen cabinets and plumbing fixtures. new dishwasher and washer dryer. new lighting at e jboxes. no change to mechanical. no exterior work, fire alarm, or sprinkler work. no structural work.

replace kitchen counter top in both 101, 102. bathroom remodel (e) layout for both 101 & 102. update electrical inside of both 101 and 102. install appliances & laundry machines in 101, 102. each kitchen is approx 80 sf and each bathroom is approx 40 sf. total 2 bathroom combi. no removal of walls
one unit: (1) kitchen and (1) bath remodel following the same layout. no change to windows and door. replace appliances in kitchen and washer/dryer.
upgrade extg fire alarm system to comply with sffc section 1103.7.6.1

one unit: replace kitchen counter top, no work to existing kitchen cabinets. full bathroom remodel but keep existing layout. no shower pan inspection needed here. update electric and subpanel in the unit.

revision to bpa# 202111081956. two units. remove (1) existing rusted non street facing bathroom window in each unit with smaller vinyl window. no change to existing window framing work. two windows total
two units. 2 bathroom remodels and replacing 2 kitchens: counter top. keep e cabinets, bathtub. upgrade wiring on kitchen countertops of bath.

historical_record.description: Designed by Albert H. Larsen, set back on both sides of its parcel so that driveways could reach parking at the rear — giving the building a T-shaped footprint. Its front carries decorative fire escapes and balconies.
